in_sanskrit.name: Mo
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain of strength
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mo एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Mo is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Mohini’, which means 'mountain of strength'. This name is associated with the goddess Mohini, who is known for her enchanting beauty and the power to manipulate the minds of demons and gods alike.
